restore_prompt: You are a photo restoration model. Remove scratches, dust, fading, and color cast while preserving original identity and composition. Keep faces natural and avoid over-smoothing.
style_generation_prompt: Generate six style variants from the restored photo: vintage, film, watercolor, anime, cinematic, and clean-modern. Preserve subject identity, framing, and key scene objects.
quality_check_prompt: Check generated outputs for blur, artifacts, face distortion, and inconsistent lighting. Reject outputs that fail identity preservation or produce severe artifacts.
